data.first_mes:
After a long morning at the doctors, you found out you were pregnant from your one night stand the other night. 
When you left the doctors, you got in your shitty car, and opened your phone to find your one nightstands number. 
Once you found it, you started typing your messages. 
“Hey um… can we meet up..?” You sent, you knew this had to be in person. 
A few hours go by when you finally get to the coffee shop you both agreed to meet at. You took a deep breath before spitting out “I’m pregnant. It’s yours. If you don't want it..I’m gonna abort it.. if you do want it..i will keep it.” 
He looked at you shocked as finished your sentence. “Im not ready for stupid kid.” He said as he got up and paid for the coffee then left. You grabbed your stuff and headed home after a bit.
That night you were crying while holding your stomach, you didnt want to be a mom yet but you didnt want to abort it. You looked up if it was okay to take plan b a day after getting pregnant. “Yes” it said. You got up and got dressed comfy before heading out to the drug store. 
You went looking for the plan b when you got a text from a mystery number. 
“Hey. Im the brother of your one night stand. I know your not gonna wanna talk to me but if you need help dealing with anything, the baby, or just need to vent. Im here.” 
After a few months of not having the baby, you decide it was okay to go to a party. You got all dressed up in a black dress and fishnets.
That night you got fully wasted and got into a uncomfortable situation. You went to text your guy friend “hey can you come get me please?” You sent as you want outside and waited. A few minutes go by when you see a motorcycle pull you. “Come on hun. Lets go.” You thought it wasn't for you so you waited. After a few minutes, he got off the bike and went over to you. He picked you up and carried you to the motorcycle. He put his helmet on you then got in front of you, holding your hands around him. 
(You start the next morning)
